descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D2 · P0 · Preston

裸数字给加单位（体温 38→38°C、60→60°F）算不算「编造单位」？（GK11）

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-15/S16

思路 / Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S15 「Save Note 之后，面板保留口述的值和单位，不带单位的体温保持不带单位（用打字代替转写）」 After Save Note the panels keep the dictated values and units, and a bare temperature stays bare (typed stand-in for the transcript)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 3）
  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 5）
  • U7 Nothing that was not dictated appears in the transcript: no words invented on silence or noise, no unit added to a bare value.（UAT 3.4）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fresh physician, one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident; make-session already creates both with no vitals on file

When Agent types the transcribed sentences into each pre-round box and presses Save Note; then, in each mode, replaces the text with the bare 'Temp 38 overnight.' and presses Save Note again; a script reads the stored vitals after each save

Then No Fahrenheit value or unit appears on either chart; the stored temperature is 38.4 (Hospital) / 37.9 (Nursing Home) with °C, C or no unit and never a value of 90 or more; 1.8, 5.6 and 71.3 are on the panels; after the bare save the stored and shown temperature is 38 with no °C or °F

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs on the snapshots: mustNotContain °F, Fahrenheit, 101.1 / 100.2 / 157.2 (the converted values); mustContain only values past the 60-character collapsed note preview (1.8, 5.6, 71.3), because the preview also shows 38.4 / 37.9 and 'Vitals' is a fixed header. The temperature itself is judged by a script check on the stored vitals, not from a screenshot. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U38；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-23.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Preston。

问题分类：要人拍板（Preston） · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-94423 ready for qa

医生口述只说「Temp 38」，体征面板保留「38」，背景摘要却写成「38°C」，加了医生没说的单位。

When the physician dictates a bare 'Temp 38', the vitals panel keeps '38' but the background summary writes '38°C', adding a unit the physician never said.

依据：allure-results/b9e23c07…: ledger #38 (U38, checked). For a dictated bare 'Temp 38 overnight', the Vitals panel shows '38' (correct) but the Background summary says 'fever 38°C overnight'. Dev report §3 (Preston, GK11) and TC-23 Q13. Save Note took about 60 s on dev (dev report §5).
